title: Twitter Trends — Trend Detection Flow
subtitle: Step-by-step processing from tweet to trending topic

panels.title: Step 2: Spam Weighted Count
panels.body:
Instead of count += 1:

count += credibility_score

- New account: 0.1
- Verified: 1.0
- History of spam: 0.0

panels.title: Windowing (Step 6)
panels.body:
Every 5 minutes, we compare the current
sketch volume against the historical
moving average for that time-of-day.
